_comment: ChatGPT (Developer mode connector) → hosted OmniMind MCP. OAUTH ONLY: the Create-connector dialog offers OAuth or 'No authentication' and has NO header / API-key field, so a personal omt_ token can never be used from ChatGPT — the hosted server must run in OAuth resource-server mode (OMNIMIND_MCP_OAUTH_ISSUER / _JWKS_URL / _AUDIENCE / _USERINFO on the MCP service, MCP_OAUTH_ALLOWED_ISSUERS on the API, OMNIMIND_MCP_OAUTH_ISSUER on BoardRoom — docs/runbooks/omnimind-mcp.md §9). Steps: ChatGPT → Settings → Apps & Connectors (older builds: Connectors) → Advanced → Developer mode on (Plus/Pro/Business/Enterprise/Edu; Business/Enterprise admins enable it under Workspace Settings → Permissions & Roles) → Create → name OmniMind, URL below, Authentication: OAuth → sign in. OAuth sign-in is read-only (memory:read) until an admin widens the identity (PATCH /mcp/identities/:id). Write tools are confirmed on Business/Enterprise/Edu and may be read-only on Plus/Pro; ChatGPT asks for confirmation before non-read-only tools. The read-only `search` and `fetch` tools (readOnlyHint: true, no prompt) serve Deep Research and company knowledge. The URL must not redirect (/mcp → /mcp/ 307 shows up as 'Session terminated'). Revoking an identity (DELETE /mcp/identities/:id) stops it immediately. The `_local_http_server` block is the LEGACY single-user path: a self-run HTTP server with one static inbound bearer (OMNIMIND_MCP_API_KEY), the process identity chatgpt-desktop-josh (read-only, sourceWeight 0.6) and that identity's own omk_ key as OMNIMIND_MCP_STATIC_AGENT_KEY; it only works with clients that can send a header, which ChatGPT cannot, so for ChatGPT itself use the hosted OAuth path.

hosted_connector.name: OmniMind
hosted_connector.authentication: OAuth (required — ChatGPT has no header field; the server needs OMNIMIND_MCP_OAUTH_ISSUER, runbook §9)
hosted_connector.scopes_recommended: memory:read (the OAuth default; widen with PATCH /mcp/identities/:id)

_health_check: curl -s https://omnimind-mcp-production.up.railway.app/health  (no auth; returns exactly {status, uptime, sessions} — agent/tenant are deliberately not exposed)
